description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between BLEU score and average lagging (AL) for four different models: Consistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE, Inconsistency-CE-MP, and a fourth model represented by the red line with star markers. The x-axis, labeled "Average Lagging (AL)", ranges from 0 to 6 with a linear scale, while the y-axis, labeled "BLEU", ranges from 12 to 28, also on a linear scale. The Consistency-CE model, shown with a purple dotted line and circle markers, starts at a BLEU score of approximately 13.5 at an AL of 0 and increases to about 26.5 at an AL of 6. The Inconsistency-CE model, represented by a dark purple dashed line with square markers, begins at a BLEU score of approximately 20.5 at an AL of 0 and rises to about 27.5 at an AL of 6. The Inconsistency-CE-MP model, depicted with a blue dashed line and square markers, starts at a BLEU score of approximately 20.5 at an AL of 0 and increases to about 27.5 at an AL of 6. The fourth model, shown with a red solid line and star markers, starts at a BLEU score of approximately 22.5 at an AL of 0 and increases to about 27.5 at an AL of 6. All four models show a general upward trend in BLEU score as average lagging increases.
